name: Instant AI Guru Chat Widget
author: Instant AI Guru

sections.description:
Instant AI Guru Chat Widget integrates an AI-powered assistant into your WordPress site. This plugin adds a lightweight and efficient chat widget for your website visitors, enabling them to interact with your custom AI assistant.

Key Features:
– Seamless integration with your WordPress site.
– Enables AI-powered customer support or FAQs.
– Fully customizable AI Assistant through your Instant AI Guru subscription.

Important Notes:
– This plugin is intended exclusively for subscribers of Instant AI Guru. It requires an active subscription for functionality.
– The plugin integrates with the Instant AI Guru service, which collects and processes chat data for quality monitoring and reporting purposes.
– By using this plugin, you agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

External services

This plugin connects to an API to provide the AI Customer Service Agent functionality of instantAIguru.com

It sends each and every prompt the user enters into the Widget to the instantAIguru.com API in order to generate the AI reply for the user’s prompt.
The Service is provided by “instantAIguru.com”: https://instantaiguru.com/terms https://instantaiguru.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress admin area or upload the ZIP file to the Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin section.
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Instant AI Guru to configure the widget script URL (optional).
  4. If you don’t modify the URL, the plugin will use the default widget provided by Instant AI Guru.
sections.faq:
Do I need an Instant AI Guru subscription to use this plugin?

Yes, an active Instant AI Guru subscription is required. Visit instantAIguru.com for details on how to subscribe.

What data does the plugin collect?

The plugin itself does not collect any data. However, the chat widget integrated via this plugin collects chat interactions for quality monitoring and analytics as part of the Instant AI Guru service.

Can I customize the widget?

Yes! You can configure the widget through your Instant AI Guru dashboard at https://instantAIguru.com and optionally modify the plugin settings to set colors to match your theme as well as modify the Heading, Welcome Message, and the Chat User’s generic name.
